title: Session report
description: Laps, driver pace, pit stops and stints for one session. Every panel reads the session picked at the top, not the dashboard time range.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) UNION SELECT current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) v WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (vehicle_id = current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) DESC NULLS LAST, 1
list.query: SELECT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) UNION SELECT current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) v WHERE vehicle_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (vehicle_id = current_setting('openlaps.vehicle_id', true)) DESC NULLS LAST, 1
list.description: Opens on the vehicle this pit is deployed for (OPENLAPS_VEHICLE_ID); any other vehicle with data in the time range can be picked.

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
list.definition: SELECT concat(to_char(min(crossed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' UTC ', COALESCE(max(session_type), 'no session'), ' at ', COALESCE(NULLIF(max(track_name), ''), 'unknown track'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY min(crossed_at) DESC
list.description: Every session this vehicle has laps in, newest first, whatever the time range. Opens on the newest.

list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.query: SELECT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') GROUP BY driver ORDER BY driver
list.definition: SELECT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') GROUP BY driver ORDER BY driver
list.description: Drivers with laps in the selected session.

list.name: stint
list.label: Stint
list.query: SELECT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' - ', COALESCE(max(driver), 'unattributed'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') GROUP BY stint_number ORDER BY stint_number
list.definition: SELECT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' - ', COALESCE(max(driver), 'unattributed'), ' (', count(*), ' laps)') AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') GROUP BY stint_number ORDER BY stint_number
list.description: Stints of the selected session, in order.

panels.title: Lap times by driver
panels.description: One point per clean lap: valid, timed, and with no pit entry or exit inside it. Across is the lap's number in the session, counted in crossing order; up is the lap time. Laps slower than 130% of the session's best clean lap (safety car, traffic jams) are left out so the racing laps fill the panel. The Laps table below lists every lap.

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_lap AS "Lap", lap_time_s * 1000 AS "Lap time", COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed') AS "Driver" FROM (SELECT *, min(lap_time_s) FILTER (WHERE clean) OVER () AS best_s FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session') laps WHERE clean AND lap_time_s <= 1.3 * best_s AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND ('$stint' = 'all' OR stint_number::text = '$stint') ORDER BY session_lap

panels.title: Best lap and best theoretical lap

targets.rawSql: WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, lap_time_s FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND clean), sectors AS (SELECT s.sector, min(s.split_time_s) AS best_s FROM laps l JOIN v_lap_sectors s ON s.lap_id = l.lap_id GROUP BY s.sector) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT min(lap_time_s) FROM laps) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor(((SELECT min(lap_time_s) FROM laps)) / 60)::int, ':', to_char(((SELECT min(lap_time_s) FROM laps)) - 60 * floor(((SELECT min(lap_time_s) FROM laps)) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Best lap", CASE WHEN (SELECT sum(best_s) FROM sectors) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor(((SELECT sum(best_s) FROM sectors)) / 60)::int, ':', to_char(((SELECT sum(best_s) FROM sectors)) - 60 * floor(((SELECT sum(best_s) FROM sectors)) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Best theoretical lap"

panels.description: Fastest clean lap of the session, and the sum of the fastest sector 1, 2 and 3 from clean laps, whoever set them. m:ss.mmm.

panels.title: Driver pace: best, median and best sectors
panels.description: Clean laps only. Median is the middle lap, so a few slow laps do not move it. The best sectors are each driver's own; Theoretical is their sum.

targets.rawSql: WITH laps AS (SELECT lap_id, driver, lap_time_s FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND clean), sectors AS (SELECT l.driver, s.sector, min(s.split_time_s) AS best_s FROM laps l JOIN v_lap_sectors s ON s.lap_id = l.lap_id GROUP BY l.driver, s.sector), pace AS (SELECT driver, count(*) AS laps, min(lap_time_s) AS best_s, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s) AS median_s FROM laps GROUP BY driver), split AS (SELECT driver, max(best_s) FILTER (WHERE sector = 1) AS s1, max(best_s) FILTER (WHERE sector = 2) AS s2, max(best_s) FILTER (WHERE sector = 3) AS s3, sum(best_s) AS theoretical_s FROM sectors GROUP BY driver) SELECT COALESCE(p.driver, 'unattributed') AS "Driver", p.laps AS "Clean laps", CASE WHEN p.best_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((p.best_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((p.best_s) - 60 * floor((p.best_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Best", CASE WHEN p.median_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((p.median_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((p.median_s) - 60 * floor((p.median_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Median", CASE WHEN s.s1 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((s.s1) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((s.s1) - 60 * floor((s.s1) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Best S1", CASE WHEN s.s2 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((s.s2) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((s.s2) - 60 * floor((s.s2) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Best S2", CASE WHEN s.s3 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((s.s3) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((s.s3) - 60 * floor((s.s3) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Best S3", CASE WHEN s.theoretical_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((s.theoretical_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((s.theoretical_s) - 60 * floor((s.theoretical_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Theoretical" FROM pace p LEFT JOIN split s ON s.driver IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.driver ORDER BY p.median_s

panels.title: Laps
panels.description: Every lap of the session, newest first, for the driver and stint picked at the top. Lap is the count in crossing order; the car's own counter restarts when its agent does. Note says why a lap is not a clean one: stop (a whole pit stop inside the lap), in, out, or invalid.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.session_lap AS "Lap", COALESCE(l.driver, '-') AS "Driver", l.stint_number AS "Stint", l.lap_in_stint AS "Lap in stint", CASE WHEN l.lap_time_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((l.lap_time_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((l.lap_time_s) - 60 * floor((l.lap_time_s) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Time", CASE WHEN s.s1 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((s.s1) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((s.s1) - 60 * floor((s.s1) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "S1", CASE WHEN s.s2 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((s.s2) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((s.s2) - 60 * floor((s.s2) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "S2", CASE WHEN s.s3 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((s.s3) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((s.s3) - 60 * floor((s.s3) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "S3", concat_ws(', ', NULLIF(l.lap_kind, 'flying'), CASE WHEN NOT l.valid THEN 'invalid' END) AS "Note", l.crossed_at AS time FROM (SELECT * FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND ('$stint' = 'all' OR stint_number::text = '$stint')) l LEFT JOIN (SELECT lap_id, max(split_time_s) FILTER (WHERE sector = 1) AS s1, max(split_time_s) FILTER (WHERE sector = 2) AS s2, max(split_time_s) FILTER (WHERE sector = 3) AS s3 FROM v_lap_sectors WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' GROUP BY lap_id) s ON s.lap_id = l.lap_id ORDER BY l.crossed_at DESC

panels.title: Pit stops
panels.description: One row per pit-lane visit. Pit lane time runs from the pit entry line to the pit exit line; Refuel bay is the time between the refuel lines inside it. Time lost is the lap holding the stop less the session's median clean lap. Driver and stint are the ones the car left with. A stop still running reads OPEN and is never shown as completed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.session_lap AS "Lap", COALESCE(l.driver, '-') AS "Driver out", l.stint_number AS "Stint", CASE WHEN p.duration_s IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((p.duration_s) / 60)::int, ':', to_char(floor((p.duration_s))::int % 60, 'FM00')) END AS "Pit lane time", CASE WHEN (SELECT sum(r.duration_s) FROM v_pit_stops r WHERE r.vehicle_id = p.vehicle_id AND r.stop_type = 'refuel' AND r.entry_at >= p.entry_at AND r.entry_at < COALESCE(p.exit_at, 'infinity')) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor(((SELECT sum(r.duration_s) FROM v_pit_stops r WHERE r.vehicle_id = p.vehicle_id AND r.stop_type = 'refuel' AND r.entry_at >= p.entry_at AND r.entry_at < COALESCE(p.exit_at, 'infinity'))) / 60)::int, ':', to_char(floor(((SELECT sum(r.duration_s) FROM v_pit_stops r WHERE r.vehicle_id = p.vehicle_id AND r.stop_type = 'refuel' AND r.entry_at >= p.entry_at AND r.entry_at < COALESCE(p.exit_at, 'infinity'))))::int % 60, 'FM00')) END AS "Refuel bay", CASE WHEN CASE WHEN l.lap_kind = 'stop' THEN l.lap_time_s - (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s) FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND clean) END IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((CASE WHEN l.lap_kind = 'stop' THEN l.lap_time_s - (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s) FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND clean) END) / 60)::int, ':', to_char(floor((CASE WHEN l.lap_kind = 'stop' THEN l.lap_time_s - (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s) FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND clean) END))::int % 60, 'FM00')) END AS "Time lost", CASE WHEN p.is_open THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'done' END AS "Status", p.entry_at AS time FROM (SELECT * FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session') l JOIN v_pit_stops p ON p.vehicle_id = l.vehicle_id AND p.stop_type = 'unknown' AND p.entry_at > l.lap_start_at AND p.entry_at <= l.crossed_at ORDER BY p.entry_at

panels.title: Time lost at each stop
panels.description: The lap holding each stop less the session's median clean lap, in minutes:seconds. It counts the slow drive in and out as well as the time stationary.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('Lap ', l.session_lap, ' ', COALESCE(l.driver, '')) AS "Stop", greatest(l.lap_time_s - (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s) FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND clean), 0) * 1000 AS "Time lost" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND lap_kind = 'stop') l ORDER BY l.crossed_at

panels.title: Driver consistency: median, best and spread
panels.description: Clean laps only. Spread is the gap between a driver's quicker quarter and slower quarter of laps, in seconds: small means repeatable. Within 1% counts laps within 1% of that driver's own best.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed') AS "Driver", count(*) AS "Clean laps", CASE WHEN percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s)) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s)) - 60 * floor((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s)) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Median lap", CASE WHEN min(lap_time_s) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((min(lap_time_s)) / 60)::int, ':', to_char((min(lap_time_s)) - 60 * floor((min(lap_time_s)) / 60), 'FM00.000')) END AS "Best lap", round((percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s) - percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s))::numeric, 2) AS "Spread (s)", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE lap_time_s <= best_s * 1.01) / count(*)) AS "Within 1% (%)" FROM (SELECT *, min(lap_time_s) OVER (PARTITION BY driver) AS best_s FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND clean) paced GROUP BY driver ORDER BY percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lap_time_s)

panels.title: Fuel per lap by driver
panels.description: Mean fuel used per clean lap, from the ECU's fuel-used counter. Laps with a pit visit or a counter reset inside them are left out.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(l.driver, 'unattributed') AS "Driver", avg(f.fuel_used_l) AS "Mean fuel per lap" FROM (SELECT * FROM v_session_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND clean) l JOIN v_lap_fuel f ON f.lap_id = l.lap_id WHERE f.measurement_status = 'clean' GROUP BY l.driver ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Driving time by driver
panels.description: Driving time is the sum of a driver's lap times less the time spent in the pit lane, which is counted against the driver who left the pits. Compare with the event's driving-time rules. Fuel is the counter total over the laps it could be measured on.

targets.rawSql: WITH stops AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT entry_at, duration_s FROM v_pit_stops WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND stop_type = 'unknown' AND NOT is_open), laps AS (SELECT l.lap_id, l.driver, l.stint_number, l.lap_time_s - COALESCE((SELECT sum(p.duration_s) FROM stops p WHERE p.entry_at > l.lap_start_at AND p.entry_at <= l.crossed_at), 0) AS drive_s FROM v_session_laps l WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND session_id::text = '$session'), stints AS (SELECT driver, stint_number, sum(drive_s) AS stint_s FROM laps GROUP BY driver, stint_number) SELECT COALESCE(l.driver, 'unattributed') AS "Driver", count(DISTINCT l.stint_number) AS "Stints", count(*) AS "Laps", CASE WHEN sum(l.drive_s) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor((sum(l.drive_s)) / 3600)::int, ':', to_char(floor((sum(l.drive_s)) / 60)::int % 60, 'FM00'), ':', to_char(floor((sum(l.drive_s)))::int % 60, 'FM00')) END AS "Driving time", CASE WHEN (SELECT max(stint_s) FROM stints st WHERE st.driver IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.driver) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE concat(floor(((SELECT max(stint_s) FROM stints st WHERE st.driver IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.driver)) / 3600)::int, ':', to_char(floor(((SELECT max(stint_s) FROM stints st WHERE st.driver IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.driver)) / 60)::int % 60, 'FM00'), ':', to_char(floor(((SELECT max(stint_s) FROM stints st WHERE st.driver IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.driver)))::int % 60, 'FM00')) END AS "Longest stint", round(sum(f.fuel_used_l)::numeric, 1) AS "Fuel measured (L)" FROM laps l LEFT JOIN v_lap_fuel f ON f.lap_id = l.lap_id AND f.measurement_status = 'clean' GROUP BY l.driver ORDER BY sum(l.drive_s) DESC
